name: Mundora: Globe & Geography
subtitle: The world on one globe
short: Maps of everything, history in stories, a travel guide and daily map games.
promo: Spin the globe and learn the world: every country, capital and flag, more than 170 maps, hundreds of stories through history, and something new to play every day.
description:
Mundora is the world on one globe: its countries and cities, its nature, its history and its sky.

EXPLORE
• More than 170 maps on a 3D globe: languages, climate, animals and plants, earthquakes and volcanoes, the oceans' depths, population, wealth and many more.
• Every country's states and provinces, its cities and capitals, with a card of facts for each.
• Satellite and terrain in detail, in 3D, and the planets, the Moon and the night sky.

TRAVEL THROUGH TIME
• Hundreds of stories on the map: wars and empires, explorers and trade routes, inventions, plagues and disasters, music, books and art.
• Borders through the centuries, the continents moving over millions of years, and the lives of famous people step by step.
• Guided tours of cities and of history, read aloud if you like.

LEARN AND PLAY
• Today: a daily challenge, a map game and the country of the day, the same for everyone.
• Master the world: capitals, flags, countries, outlines, big cities, landmarks, rivers, mountains and seas, with spaced repetition so they stay with you.
• Fill the map, Put it on the map, and 14 map games.
• Streaks, badges and a gentle daily reminder only if you want one.

PLAN A TRIP
• A travel guide to almost 700 cities: what to eat, what to see, museums and day trips, and a trip plan you can share.

No account and no ads. What you do stays on your device. In English, Spanish, Portuguese, French and German.
whatsNew: Now in Portuguese, French and German: the whole app, the map's names, and every quiz, game and deck.
